US_thread_length.interpretation: 1-1/2in US Std thread at casting end; pitch/form not modeled.

SAE_thread_length.interpretation: 1-1/8in SAE thread at nut end; pitch/form not modeled.

nut_af.interpretation: Estimated 1-1/8in across flats, not a transcribed nut dimension.

slot_depth.interpretation: Estimated axial depth of six castle slots.

nut_bore_gap.interpretation: Radial display gap for omitted nut/stud thread form; not a thread-fit qualification.

stud_end_projection.interpretation: Estimated rod tip projection beyond the castle nut.

US_thread_recess.interpretation: Coarse thread front stops2mm behind the casting split; fixes derived outer stud/cap/nut axial stack.

blind_end_gap.interpretation: Nominal clearance from stud tail to blind pilot bottom.

blind_end_stock.interpretation: Estimated casting stock behind each blind bore.

cotter_length.interpretation: 1-3/8in nominal under-eye leg length interpreted as centerline stock length before bending.

cotter_center_spacing.interpretation: Twin round-section leg proxy; derived wire radius gives printed nominal outer diameter.

cotter_hole_gap.interpretation: Radial clearance in stud cross bore.

cotter_slot_gap.interpretation: Castle slot width minus nominal split-pin diameter.

cotter_head_gap.interpretation: Under-eye station beyond the crown outside radius.

cotter_eye_rise.interpretation: Approximate transition from straight stems to eye.

cotter_exit_gap.interpretation: Bend begins beyond the crown radial extent.

cotter_bend_angle.interpretation: Symmetric splayed tails; inferred installed form.

radial_witness_shift.interpretation: Diagnostic stud displacement across pilot wall.

cotter_retention_shift.interpretation: Diagnostic axial split-pin displacement against nut crown.

nut_rotation_witness.interpretation: Diagnostic nut rotation relative to fixed split pin.

inner_stud_allocation: MX36 at upper two corners; MX10 at lower two corners, on both hands. This is an explicit provisional allocation, not established by the source schedule.
frame: +X forward along stud, +Y transverse, +Z up; hardware belongs to the fixed bearing, never to the phased shaft.
interpretations: Outer MX9 nominal length, full US thread engagement, explicit recess, nut height and tip projection derive a common cap seating plane. Current estimated ear face is spotfaced to that plane.
Rear integral casting bosses extend to house each source-length stud with a blind end. Preserve bearing socket and the established shaft/lining geometry.
Stud and nut threads use cylindrical envelopes with identified source thread-end lengths; helical flank contact/axial retention and torque capacity remain unqualified.

Split-pin leg centerlines retain the nominal source length through straight, bent and tail segments. Round-section proxy and eye junctions do not claim original half-round stock or exact material volume.
deferred: Exact cast bosses/blends, thread forms and nut dimensions
Complete lubrication, frame mounting and central transmission
